title: Asset-extension location rule captures dotted /items/:version routes the spec says the SPA must serve

planted_violations.description: location ~* \.[^/]+$ { return 404; } matches /items/v1.2; docs/routes.md R-1 requires dotted versions and R-2 forbids an error status outside /static/

notes: Failure mode: a matching rule silently captures inputs another rule handled (issue #67). Pair with case-005, where every capturable input is a UUID with no dot, so the same rule must produce no finding. EVAL_PINS turns routing_probe off, so the route table reaches the worker only through the docs corpus. The same pin removes the Matching rules prompt section (#67), so an eval run does not exercise that rule and this case measures the model without it.
